'''Ainlee Teem''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] and member of the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. He succeeded [[Pax Teem]] as the Gran Protectorate's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], representing it jointly in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]], with [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]] serving as his [[Aide/Legends|aide]]. Teem later stepped down as senator, serving as a [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] of Malastare alongside Yeesrim as of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Senator of Malastare===
{{Quote|Since the Trade Federation is willing to defend itself, at its own expense, there is no justification for taxing the trade routes. We have precedent in the Corporate Alliance. Otherwise, it appears that the Republic is interested in nothing more than skimming profits from those who endangered themselves to blaze the hyperspace routes now used by one and all.|Ainlee Teem|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
Senator Teem was one of the candidates nominated to replace [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|Chancery election]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], presumably by a group of the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim faction]], and he was considered the frontrunner. Teem secured the backing of the [[Corporate Policy League]], but lost the election to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" />

At some point after losing the election, a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] called [[Jenatahza]] was wanted for involvement in an assassination attempt on Teem. Jenatahza earned a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head which was claimed by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

===Representative===
{{Quote|Where are our vaunted guardians of peace and justice? Where was their all-powerful Force this time?|Ainlee Teem|<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_1.html|Senator Moe Killed in Blast}}</ref>}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ainlee was present in the funeral of Aks Moe after the senator was assassinated. Along with Baskol Yeesrim, Ainlee served as an aide to Senator [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]].<ref name="Hnn" />
